prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1371; do not mention it.)
text:
Please be advised that this office now represents our client in connection with the motor vehicle collision that occurred while our client was making a left turn and was struck by another vehicle. Our client has sustained injuries as a result of this incident and is currently receiving medical care.

Effective immediately, all communication regarding this matter, including requests for statements, recorded or otherwise, and any settlement discussions, must be directed exclusively to this office. Please do not contact our client directly.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to the insured driver and any other policies that may afford coverage for this loss, along with a copy of the declarations page.

We further demand that your company preserve all evidence relating to this claim. This includes photographs, vehicle data, telematics and event data recorder information, claim file materials, adjuster notes, recorded statements, and any other documentation in your possession, custody, or control. Please confirm in writing that these materials are being retained.
